purpose: The ownership manifest for the Gate B shared-PDF correction lane: the frozen 26-family correction denominator, the three escalations this lane owns, every implementation path it may touch classified against the release-input sets, and the boundary against the evidence-completion lane.

sharedFilesSplitByRegion.thisLaneOwns: the field census, the effective-label and widget-geometry capture, the call into decideBinding, and the caption-slot arbitration applied to its result
sharedFilesSplitByRegion.evidenceLaneOwns: the artifactProvenance(...) call site and the artifact-provenance.json write beneath it
sharedFilesSplitByRegion.howTheSplitHolds: the two regions do not overlap: this lane's edits end before the render block, and the provenance call reads `bindings` as an opaque array rather than any field this lane adds

mayNotDo: modify a family source binary, source receipt, field map, overlay profile, classification, fixture, finalized artifact, provenance sidecar or contact sheet
rerender any family; the PDF implementation lane owns that and receives a handoff instead
edit an independent-review verdict, self-approve a family, or hand-edit a register count
merge to main, publish a worker, deploy, or touch hosted acceptance

denominator.howAMissingFileIsTreated: counted. The denominator is the reviewer's decision, not the contents of this branch's working tree, so a family whose artifact is absent here is reported as absent and still carried.

releaseInputClassification.verdict: Every path this lane touches is outside both the worker image-input set and the application input set. The corrections run at build time in this repository and are not reachable from the worker image even transitively: the Dockerfile copies scripts/rcap-render-worker.mjs, scripts/lib/ and src/, and none of those reference scripts/rcap-official-forms/. No rebuild, no republication, no Gate A effect.

escalations.exactContract: decideBinding(field, options) — `field` gains `rect` and `regionHeading`; a binding whose widget falls inside a page region whose printed heading is protected is refused on geometry whatever the field is called
escalations.reviewerConditionFailed: protection established by geometry where required, not label alone
escalations.currentBehaviour: decideBinding() receives { name, pdfType, effectiveLabel } and effectiveLabel is undefined for every field of every family, so `subject = effectiveLabel ?? name` resolves to the internal AcroForm field name. Widget rects are captured into field-census.json and never passed. Geometry is not an input to protection.
escalations.requiredBehaviour: The widget rect and the printed caption above it are inputs to decideBinding, and a binding whose rect falls inside a court-owned page region is refused whatever the field is called.
escalations.smallestSharedCorrection: The widget rect and the printed caption above it are inputs to decideBinding, and a binding whose rect falls inside a court-owned page region is refused whatever the field is called.
escalations.reproductionFixture: a synthesised AcroForm whose protected widget is named innocuously and sits under a printed protected heading
escalations.baselineFailure: the widget binds a participant fact because only its name reaches the binder
escalations.negativeControl: an identically-named widget outside any protected region still binds
escalations.mutationThatMustTurnRed: Rename a protected field to an innocuous name and re-derive: the binder must still refuse it on geometry.
escalations.whyNoFamilyCorrectionSubstitutes: The field maps are generated. A hand-edited map is overwritten by the next re-derivation, and hand-editing 20 of them would leave the defect live for every family added afterwards.
escalations.familyOwnedWorkRemainingAfterwards: re-derive each field map and re-render. The maps are generated, so no family file is hand-edited.

escalations.exactContract: selectOnePerCaptionSlot(candidates) — among writable widgets that carry the same fact and overlap on a page, exactly one survives; and an unselected choice field's prompt is cleared before flatten
escalations.reviewerConditionFailed: no clipping, no silent truncation, no duplicated preprinted caption
escalations.currentBehaviour: Every widget in a multi-purpose caption band is bound. After flattening, variants that JavaScript used to show and hide all render at once, overlapping, covering the court's own printed words, and unfilled dropdowns keep their prompt text ('Choose the court') as ink on a filed pleading.
escalations.requiredBehaviour: Exactly one field per caption slot is bound and the rest refused; an unfilled dropdown's prompt is suppressed at flatten.
escalations.smallestSharedCorrection: Exactly one field per caption slot is bound and the rest refused; an unfilled dropdown's prompt is suppressed at flatten.
escalations.reproductionFixture: a synthesised page with two overlapping widgets binding one fact, plus a dropdown whose default option is a chooser prompt
escalations.baselineFailure: both widgets bind and render ~5pt apart, and the unselected prompt flattens to ink
escalations.negativeControl: two widgets carrying the same fact that do NOT overlap both survive — a form may legitimately repeat a caption fact on two lines
escalations.mutationThatMustTurnRed: Flatten a form with an unselected dropdown: the prompt string must not appear in the page content stream.
escalations.whyNoFamilyCorrectionSubstitutes: Five Nebraska families share one caption block. The selection rule is in the binder, not in any of their maps.
escalations.familyOwnedWorkRemainingAfterwards: re-render the five Nebraska families and read the caption band in the raster
